name: Suregaru
source:
The protagonist Konori Mochizuki is a student of Restoration magic at the magical academy. She has great heart, but her grades are the lowest of the low.
Her teacher Jidono points out that she won't be able to graduate at this rate.
Realizing that she has to work harder Konori takes up his offer of a month of special training, but...
